\section{\texttt{generate\_feedback\_rows}}
\label{func:feedback_intelligence_agent.synthetic_data.generate_feedback_rows}\index{Functions!generate\_feedback\_rows}

Generate synthetic feedback rows compatible with the data contract.
\apifield{Usage}
\begin{lstlisting}[style=usage, language=Python]
generate_feedback_rows(config: SyntheticDataConfig) -> list[dict[str, str]]
\end{lstlisting}
\apifield{Arguments}
